status: Software qualified on full optimized arm64 and translated Intel component tests; native/physical/platform acceptance pending

container.header: Existing8-byte chunked magic, little-endian UInt32 version64, UInt32 reserved0
container.footer: PHTEND64 followed by UInt64 manifest offset, UInt64 manifest length and32-byte SHA256 manifest digest
container.index: Unchanged bounded authenticated63 B-tree, ordinal blobs and raster reference pages
container.agreement: Header, manifest and footer versions must agree.63 remains readable/writable for documents not requiring64.

feature.coverage: Surface payload with u8 depth, sRGB numeric encoding, opaque alpha1, equal RGB components and exact0...255/255 GRAY8 values. Cached bounds are derived from the samples.
feature.legacy: Dense bytes/historyBytes remain unchanged below the36MP bound; pagedCoverage cannot be mixed with them.
feature.large: Paged selection dimensions must exceed36MP and match the selection/document grid. Generated empty coverage is discarded by setCoverageSelection.
feature.context: Writing pagedCoverage requires an owned raster-blob context. Native64 supplies indexed ordinals; history supplies its owned blob codec.
feature.versioning: Any document containing paged selection coverage requires native64; ordinary public saves select it automatically. Generic inline encode delegates to the indexed container for such documents.

limits: Existing file/metadata/scratch/heap admissions remain; current physical backing uses16-byte RGBA Float samples rather than compact one-byte coverage. Full dense capacity and physical/platform/Photoshop qualification remain open.
